5733.title: Mutable plugin loads rewrite unchanged host artifacts
5733.rootCauseOneLine: The mutable host loader invokes the host builder on every load without checking SDK metadata or source freshness; the builder recompiles and replaces the artifact.
5733.proposedFix: Guard mutable host builds with SDK metadata and the existing source freshness walk; retain artifact integrity checks.
5733.caveats: Reproduction and exact output are inline. No whole-server timing measurement; builtin eligibility verified statically.
